值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解飼主面對愛犬嚴重挑食時的真實困擾與各種妙趣橫生的應對嘗試。
  • 見證作者意外買錯整人惡臭噴霧，導致全家人被燻到淚流滿面、緊急逃難的幽默插曲。
  • 揭曉網路瘋傳的「誘食神級噴霧」對挑食狗狗究竟是否真有神奇成效。

摘要

挑食愛犬與神秘噴霧的由來

作者的愛犬 Taizou 最近出現了嚴重的挑食問題，寧可天天啃樹葉或暴風吸入零食，也堅決不肯碰碗裡的狗糧。為了解決這項難題，作者聽取養狗朋友的建議，決定購入網路上據說能利用獨特氣味激發狗狗食慾的特殊氣味噴霧來進行實測。

誤買整人噴霧引發的慘劇

然而出師不利，作者的妻子不小心買成了整人用的惡臭噴霧。當作者試著打開時，惡臭瞬間沾上手指並瀰漫四周，愛犬 Taizou 當場嚇得落荒而逃，全家人更被燻到眼淚直流，不得不敞開門窗奔向戶外避難，場面極度混亂失控。

正版誘食噴霧實測與殘酷結局

三天後，作者秉持嚴謹態度買來與影片一模一樣的正版噴霧。這款產品散發出飼料伴隨大蒜的香氣，狗狗聞了之後果然沒有逃跑。作者滿懷期待地將噴霧噴在狗糧上並架設鏡頭觀察，沒想到 Taizou 僅僅上前嗅了嗅便轉身離開，對狗糧依舊毫無興趣，反倒轉頭興高采烈地吃起零食，宣告這場誘食實驗徹底破局。

================================================

It all started because Lumi recently. became a picky eater and stopped liking. dog food. >> Our dog Taizou has the exact same. symptoms as the dog in that video:. eating, eating, eating. But he won't. even touch his dog food. >> Yet he never goes hungry. >> Why eat anything else, you're eating. charcoal!

>> It's not like he's full; just offer him. a treat and you'll see. Look, he's. eating it with such gusto, and quite a. lot of it too. >> He’d rather eat green leaves every. day than touch his kibble. >> He eats leaves, too. Yeah. I shared. this with my fellow dog-owner friend,. and this "genius" solemnly told me that. a foul-smelling spray is safe and.

practical. >> If we spray this stuff on dog food,. will it make our dog love eating it? >> The dogs seem quite obsessed with this. scent. >> Let's buy some and try it out. It...it. doesn't seem to be the same thing. >> Everyone looks miserable; why does it. feel like a prank prop? Is it the same. one? It looks different from the.

advertisement. My wife bought the wrong. one; their spray says "Smell for Hell" —a hellish scent that's supposed to. be awful. We got this bottle instead,. which says "Stinky Spray." It should be. the same type of thing as the one in. the video. I think we can test this. bottle first, and if it doesn't work. well, we'll go buy their "Hell" spray. Alright, it's open. Wow, my hand got.

some on it and it smells like death. Let's see if our Taizou likes this. scent. Okay, got it. He hates it,. absolutely hates it—he ran so far. away! Hey, why did everyone run outside. ? Come here, wife, take a sniff. >> Look, it's making my eyes water; look,. the windows and doors are open. Three. days later, to ensure our channel’s. rigorous standards, we bought the exact.

same one from that video. The female. host in the video sprayed it on her. hand and sniffed it, saying she felt. nothing. I'm not as brave as her, so. we’ll spray it on paper and take a. whiff. Isn't this just a feed-like,. garlicky smell? No wonder dogs like the. scent. Now, let's let Taizou have a. sniff and see if he likes it. How is it. ? He didn't run away as fiercely as.

last time. Let's spray it on his dog. food to see if he thinks it’s a good. seasoning. Put the bowl on his stand,. set up a camera, and let’s see if he. actually eats it or not. You aren't... >> He just took a sniff, but it didn't. seem to interest him, then he looked. away—he wasn't really into it. Wow,. look at how much he's enjoying those. snacks!

item.itunes:title: 用了幾天...在只需要剝幾顆蒜的情況下 我是真的會想要用它 - 按壓去皮剝蒜器
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WAG4m0nX2QM

值得閱讀的理由

  • 展示一款切蒜器的實際操作方式，了解它是否如廣告所說方便。
  • 比較切蒜器與用刀切蒜的差異，看看哪種方式更省力。
  • 呈現使用時可能遇到的狀況，以及器具清洗是否容易。

摘要

作者拿著一瓣大蒜，準備測試如何優雅地把蒜切碎。他依照廣告示範，將大蒜橫放在切蒜器上、剝皮後放入出料器，再向下按壓。

按下切蒜器後，蒜末竟然飛到作者臉上，讓這場看似優雅的切蒜示範變得有些狼狽。

接著，作者比較切蒜器和用刀切蒜的方式。切蒜器只要按一下就能完成，操作確實不太費力；不過，它不一定每次都能順利去除蒜皮，而且器具上還會殘留一些蒜末。

使用後只要用水沖洗，切蒜器便能洗乾淨。作者認為清洗效果令人滿意，這項設計整體來說頗有意思。

================================================

I have a clove of garlic in my hand. >> How do you mince garlic elegantly? >> Come on, let’s try it out. It’s a.

design just like the ad, place the. garlic horizontally on the splitter,. peel it, put it on the dispenser, and.

press down. Garlic. >> It all flew right onto my face. >> Elegant garlic crushing.

>> Let me compare it with crushing it with. a knife, timing it to see which is. easier to use.

>> Whereas this garlic press works with. just one push. Honestly, it's not. actually that much effort.

>> Though it can't guarantee the skin will. always come off. >> There's still minced garlic left on.

here. >> Just rinse it off after using. It. really does get clean with a rinse,.

it’s actually pretty cool.

=============

值得閱讀的理由

  • 揭開廣告中「超長米」的真實面貌與來源，打破對長米的迷思。
  • 真實開箱對比印度巴斯馬蒂香米與普通米在長度、煮後變化上的差異。
  • 直白呈現煮熟後的特殊氣味與實際口感評價，提供客觀的避坑參考。

摘要

網購超長米引發的好奇與探索

作者先前依照廣告購買了一款號稱超級長的貓牙米，然而身為廣西人的他收到後卻發現與平時吃的米毫無差別。後來在網友的提醒下，作者得知真正極長的米產自印度與巴基斯坦一帶，於是特地購買了原產國為印度的巴斯馬蒂香米來一探究竟。

印度長米與普通米的對比與烹煮

作者將印度香米與廣西米進行了生米外觀對照，發現印度生米確實較為修長，但仍好奇煮熟後是否真能達到如廣告般誇張的長度。在經過二十分鐘的烹煮後，米粒明顯伸長，長度甚至達到半個指節，讓在場眾人驚呼從未見過如此長的米。

意料之外的氣味與口感評價

然而在氣味上，煮熟後的長米散發出一股類似倉庫甚至老鼠屎的難聞臭味，絲毫沒有米香，與傳統米飯的撲鼻香味形成強烈對比。實際試吃後，作者指出這種米缺乏甜味，視覺效果雖極為誇張，但味道非常一般且不好吃，驗證了網友們對其口感的負面評價。

item.itunes:title: 哈？？微波爐可以煮飯？！ - 微波爐邪修煮飯
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=phtxARSJJC0

值得閱讀的理由

  • 示範用微波爐煮飯，步驟簡單，適合想嘗試不同烹調方式的人。
  • 完整呈現作者從半信半疑到實際試吃的過程，讓實驗結果更有趣。
  • 如實描述米飯上下層的口感差異，提供實用的烹煮參考。

摘要

作者看見有人用微波爐煮出米粒分明、蓬鬆又沒有硬心的米飯，便決定親自試試。他準備玻璃碗，量取一杯米，照常洗米後加入一杯水，並浸泡約二十分鐘。

浸泡完成後，作者將米放進微波爐，以高火加熱十分鐘。加熱到第九分鐘時，他看到碗中不斷冒泡，擔心米飯會不會煮成粥；時間一到，雖然碗非常燙，成品乍看之下仍像是米飯，而非稀粥。

作者試吃後發現米飯基本上已經煮熟，沒有明顯硬心，但口感不完全均勻：底層較乾、米粒較小，上層則偏軟，幾乎有點像粥。整體而言，這次微波爐煮飯的成果可以食用，作者認為效果不錯，和電鍋煮飯相差不遠。

================================================

The microwave rice is fragrant and. fluffy, with distinct grains and no. hard centers. >> I've lived for so many years and never. knew you could cook rice in a microwave.

. I’ve prepared a glass bowl just. like theirs. >> One cup of rice. >> One cup of rice; let's wash it normally. .

>> One cup of water. >> The same amount of water as the rice I. just poured in. >> Let it soak for 20 minutes. >> Okay, 21 minutes passed, it should be.

soaked, got it. >> Back into the microwave. High heat for. ten minutes. >> Nine minutes later. Why does it feel. like I've made porridge?

>> I can see the bubbles inside; I wonder. if the last minute can perform a. miracle. Time’s up. Wow, it’s so. hot. At first glance, it actually looks. like rice, not porridge, not porridge.

With 32 years of eating experience, let. me taste if this rice has any hard. spots. It’s cooked; the rice at the. bottom is a bit drier and smaller,. while the top is a bit soft, almost.

like porridge. It’s basically all. cooked. >> Actually, I think it's the same as an. electric rice cooker. It is definitely. edible; the result is quite good.

=============

item.itunes:title: 哦？！相比三年前那個進步很大的樣子 但我猜你們不會買 - 隔油湯碗
item.itunes:author: 神奇买家
item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FXvcYSQxAaw

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解如何用分油碗快速分離螺螄粉湯裡的油脂，喝湯更清爽。
  • 透過實際倒湯測試，看看分油碗的效果與仍可能存在的不足。
  • 比較新款分油碗和傳統分油湯勺，了解兩者使用上的差異。

摘要

作者展示一碗螺螄粉辣油，指出碗底仍有湯汁。他提到，連喝三碗這樣的湯，就像吞下一匙油，因此開始使用能分離油脂的分油碗。

作者回想三年前買過的傳統分油湯勺：舀湯時，勺底會碰到表面的油，倒湯也不夠俐落，油容易從邊緣溢出。相較之下，分油碗能較快濾掉油脂，方便盛出清湯。

為了測試效果，作者把看起來相當油膩的螺螄粉辣油倒進分油碗。碗上的出湯口位於較低處，倒湯時能接住湯汁，並盡量避免油脂碰到出口；不過，仍有少量油難免流過。

接著，王師傅示範傳統分油方式，作者也比較兩種工具的效果。傳統湯勺分完後，湯面仍留有一層薄油，顯示新款分油碗比起三年前的舊湯勺已有明顯改進。作者因此推薦有需要的人試用。

================================================

As you can see, this is a bowl of chili. oil from luosifen. You can see the soup. at the bottom. >> Drinking three bowls of soup is like. chugging a spoonful of oil, so I now.

use this oil-separating soup bowl that. does the work for me. >> This thing reminds me of the soup-oil. separating ladle we bought three years. ago, but with that ladle, the bottom.

touches the oily surface of the soup. when you scoop it up, making it so you. can't pour it out quickly or the oil. will just spill over the edges. >> This oil-separating bowl can quickly.

filter out grease, making it easy to. get a bowl of clear soup. >> Bought one to test it out. Highly. recommended—I'll pour the luosifen. chili oil into the oil-separating bowl.

It looks really oily, right? Let's pour. it into the bowl and see if it can. separate the oil from the soup. You can. pour it pretty fast, right? Its outlet. is here, so when we pour it, this.

outlet stays at the lowest point, and. you can still catch the oil without it. ever touching the outlet, though it’s. unavoidable that some oil gets through. Master Wang will show you his.

old-school technique—look, one shot,. damn, this oil! Is there any other way? Actually, there is. You see, I feel. like my old-school technique... >> Seems like I still have a bit more oil.

Look, there's still a thin layer of oil. on top. The separating ladle really. does get it cleaner. >> Compared to that ladle from three years. ago, this is a big improvement. Go get.

yourself one, yeah!

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解如何用分油碗快速分離螺螄粉湯裡的油脂，喝湯更清爽。
  • 透過實際倒湯測試，看看分油碗的效果與仍可能存在的不足。
  • 比較新款分油碗和傳統分油湯勺，了解兩者使用上的差異。

摘要

作者展示一碗螺螄粉辣油，指出碗底仍有湯汁。他提到，連喝三碗這樣的湯，就像吞下一匙油，因此開始使用能分離油脂的分油碗。

作者回想三年前買過的傳統分油湯勺：舀湯時，勺底會碰到表面的油，倒湯也不夠俐落，油容易從邊緣溢出。相較之下，分油碗能較快濾掉油脂，方便盛出清湯。

為了測試效果，作者把看起來相當油膩的螺螄粉辣油倒進分油碗。碗上的出湯口位於較低處，倒湯時能接住湯汁，並盡量避免油脂碰到出口；不過，仍有少量油難免流過。

接著，王師傅示範傳統分油方式，作者也比較兩種工具的效果。傳統湯勺分完後，湯面仍留有一層薄油，顯示新款分油碗比起三年前的舊湯勺已有明顯改進。作者因此推薦有需要的人試用。
